book.title: Choosing to SEE
book.description: Mary Beth Chapman, wife of Grammy award-winning recording artist Steven Curtis Chapman, shows how she wrestles with God - both during times of happiness and those of tragedy. Readers will hear first-hand about the loss of her daughter, the struggle to heal and the unexpected path God has placed her on.
